about: Node packs reviewed from their code, then loaded together on a test ComfyUI beside the studio's own nodes: none failed to import and no two register the same node id. A pack's licence is as its repository states it. Reviewed and load-tested is not the same as safe: read a pack before relying on it.
how: install.py --packs pool51 clones each pack at the commit listed here, applies its patch if it has one, and installs the pip packages listed. Nothing else is fetched at install time; some packs download model weights the first time one of their nodes runs.
